Container.Name: Windrose-Linux
Container.Overview:
** Configuration are required after first run **
**Network:** Direct Port: Port used are defined under Game Parameters. If you change them, you must remove and create the port binding.
**Configuration:** You must wait for the game to be fully initialize once, then shutdown the server to modify the config file. NEVER MODIFY WHILE THE CONTAINER IS RUNNING.
There is 2 configuration file. R5/ServerDescription.json is for the server itself (how it run). After first run, you must change these:
"IsPasswordProtected": true, "Password": "yourpassword", "UseDirectConnection": true, "DirectConnectionServerPort": 7777,
To edit World configuration and settings, you edit the file WorldDescription.json. This file will be under a random named folder like R5/Saved/SaveProfiles/Default/RocksDB/game version/Worlds/world document id/WorldDescription.json
Reference: https://playwindrose.com/dedicated-server-guide/
**Update Notice:** Since this docker is manually updated using extracted files, update will require time from the maintener.
Container.DonateText: If you like my work please consider Donating.
Container.Requires: Create the file /mnt/cache/appdata/windrose-linux/ServerDescription.json (empty) before first run
